mostWorthwhile.text: Shaping the voiced sound into “Hello” made the role of the tongue and lips concrete and connected the biology to a familiar action.

leastWorthwhile.text: Starting the outward breath felt like a routine setup step, with little to decide or learn from its result.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the greeting and reply followed the stated goal.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: each followed the route from breath to speech to hearing. The combinations were supplied, though, so I did not have to discover them.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered more meaningful choices. This ending connected body systems to a human interaction, but each decision had only one combination.
